geo_dispersion.description: A single unit's tier-2 code was scanned from too many distinct cities within the window — the physical item can't be in all of them, so counterfeit copies are likely circulating.

velocity.description: One source IP verified an unusually high number of distinct units in a short window — consistent with a scraper or bulk-verification script. Never auto-flags a unit (there is no single unit to flag); a human reviews and, if warranted, recalls the batch.

dead_code.description: A tier-2 code was verified while its batch is not yet shipped (status outside shipped/closed) — the code shouldn't be reachable by a consumer yet.

pre_reveal.description: A tier-2 code was verified before the batch's expected ship date — alert-only, since legitimate early handling (photography, QA) is common and a unit shouldn't be auto-flagged for it.

duplicate_first.description: The same unit's tier-2 code was verified twice within a short window from cities too far apart to be the same physical scan — a strong counterfeit signal.
